storylocationregen:set_desc: Sets the center of the regen radius to the player's current position.
storylocationregen:regen_desc: Starts the regen process manually with the regular 15 minute warning.
storylocationregen:forceregen_desc: Starts the regen process manually with a 1 minute warning.
storylocationregen:delete_desc: Deletes a saved location and cancels any scheduled regen.
storylocationregen:list_desc: Shows the list of currently set regen locations.
